notes.title: Zodiacats 1 Year Anniversary
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6C3fs45.png[/img]

Hi, humans! ːcathspawː

Today is Zodiacats (and Devcats) 1-year anniversary! ːlovecatː
Exactly 1 year ago we released our first game, with little hope of success but lots of love within.

We always wanted to share our love for felines and raise awareness for adoption and rescue of cats, these meowmazing creatures that had been unjustly labeled as hateful beings. Luckily that wrongful mindset is changing and cats are ruling the internet (and hopefully the world!).

We'd also like to announce that Zodiacats is coming to Nintendo Switch on January 26th!
The Nintendo Switch port was made by Silesia Games.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5e8TDUB.png[/img]

We hope this is our first of many years bringing you wholesome games! ːwinkycatː
Thank you again, humans!
Love & Purrs,
Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: New Intern
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41043020/ee2714a10d869ea23424dcad92d1bbc47a9e6b33.png[/img]

Hello humans!

2022 was a great year for us! We've released 4 games, a minigame, a comic book and a lot of aditional content for those games. Not to mention the other 4 games we are working on right now! 

That's a lot of work, so we need more paws to help us.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41043020/847000f11d17a78da8cc909892cb5a3e30e7e4cd.png[/img]

This is Leo, Devcats' new intern.
He was found all alone in our yard, feist as a little feral cat really is. We rescued him and within 5 days he bloomed into a sweet little boy, purring loud every time we pet him. ❤

If you follow us on instagram ([url=https://www.instagram.com/luadogato/]@luadogato[/url]) you already know all that.

We named him Leo and he still need to be approved by all of us cats, but most likely he's going to stay with us permanently.

~~~~~~~~~~ 

We created a special bundle for the end of the year! The purrfect christmas gift for a dearly friend!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/2976/Devcats_Collection_FOR_GIFTS/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41043020/0274ef0eaf2c0635a1a35c00ea59d9cb1b6380ae.png[/img][/url]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/2976/Devcats_Collection_FOR_GIFTS/

This bundle will only be available for a limited time.

We have a lot of plans for 2023, however we've learned that is always better to wait until the following release because we announced a bunch of games in 2022 and had to change plans for various reasons

Last but definitely not least, we would like to THANK everyone of you who have been supporting us this whole year and we wish you a happy Christmas and a PAWSOME 2023!

[i]PS: Our humans made this game. It's a really hard competitive arcade shooter but in case you like this type of game, it's on sale for a few pennies.[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1520330/TechBeat_Heart/

Love & Purrs,
Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: New plans
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41043020/df0e4fb51833ef21830e865595720dbcad8b39c3.png[/img]
Hi, lovely humans!

Today is the most special day of all the year: International Cat Day!
"It was created in 2002 by the International Fund for Animal Welfare, to raise awareness for cats and learn about ways to help and protect them" -- and that's what we've been doing (and will continue to do) in all of our current and future games: showing you humans that cats are just as cute and loving as dogs and we cats need care, love and protection just like them. ːfofino2ː

Now to the mews!
Here are some of the news about our games:

[h1][b]A BUILDING FULL OF CATS[/b][/h1]
Trading Cards and emoticons are here! ːlovecatː
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41043020/80d862d45067ef3071c257cd96d5cff155d67a52.png[/img]
The hint system is coming in a few days. This next update will also include a Dutch localization.

[h1][b]CATS LOVE BOXES[/b][/h1]
We had plans for releasing Cats Love Boxes this month. We really believe in this game but the wishlists are WAY bellow than our other games. ːsweatcatː
That's crazy of you, humans... It's a game about BOXES! How can someone not be excited about that? ːcrycat2ː
Because of that, we postponed Cats Love Boxes launch to the end of the year.

[h1][b]COZY ROOM[/b][/h1]
That's the game we're willing to launch next. We don't have a release date yet but we hope to launch it in September.

[h1][b]A CASTLE FULL OF CATS[/b][/h1]
A Castle Full of Cats development is going well and we believe it will be a worthy successor to A Building Full of Cats. ːwinkycatː
A demo will be available on the October edition of Next Fest, so you can play the game before buying it.

[h1][b]SUDOCATS[/b][/h1]
There is going to be a small content update later this month, which will also include 2 new languages: Japanese and Russian.

Well, that's it! Enjoy your cats and cats games today most of all days, in homage to all feline friends in the world!
Thank you again, humans! ❤️
Love & Purrs,
Devcats

notes.title: Catherine Update
notes.content:
Hello again, humans!
We have great mews today!

[h2][b]ZODIACATS UPDATE[/b][/h2]
This update brings you a glossary: some astrologic explanation on each term we used in sign's attributes.

There's 2 new puzzles that work as an ending for the game. These puzzles are only available after completing the zodiac wheel.

Another change with this update is the new color scheme for the light puzzle. We made it less bright so the details in the background and cats are more visible and pleasant (Virgo will no longer be a problem! ːlunar2019grinningpigː )

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bNA1BXN.png[/img]
[i]Before and after[/i]

Finally, since Zodiacats was our very first release and we had no budget at the time, the Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean localizations were just machine translations. After the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969080/A_Building_Full_of_Cats/]A Building Full of Cats[/url] success, we decided to hire translators to make this right.
Please, send us a message in the forum if there's anything wrong with these localizations, since we can't understand a thing. ːpapyruswackyː
We also included a new language: Traditional Chinese.

List of changes:
[list][*] 2 new puzzles
[*] 2 new achievements
[*] Glossary
[*] New color for the light puzzles
[*] Traditional Chinese localization
[*] Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean localization remade
[*] Catherine exit scene
[*] Devcats splash screen SFX
[/list]

[h2][b]SUPPORTER PACK UPDATE[/b][/h2]
We also updated the Supporter Pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26826/Zodiacats_Deluxe/
[list]
[*] 2 new desktop wallpapers
[*] 2 new mobile wallpapers
[*] 4 new avatars
[/list]

Hope you enjoy this update.

Thank you again, humans!
Love & Purrs,
Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: Devcats plans for 2022
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41043020/7253cac25ab7f7a984e1aed29492149d70ca0291.png[/img]
Hi there!

It’s been 4 months since we launched our very first game as Devcats and we are very grateful for the players’ reaction.

We’ve traced plans for Devcats in 2022 and we’d like to share them with you! ;)

There’s one factor that’s really important to a game on Steam: wishlists. That’s why we’ve been revealing so many games in advance. We need to have as many wishlists as we possibly can by the day of each game launch, otherwise said game will be completely lost amidst all the other current releases.

So, we politely ask you: if you’re interested in our games, remember to add them to your wishlist and follow them, so we can stand a chance among the others. ?
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41043020/da8b1ca645f41cd6e8db23975ee738b39ef09715.gif[/img]

Even if you don’t wish to buy the game right at its release, having considerable wishlists and followers helps us to gain some projection inside Steam’s algorithm. That’s right, even cats are dependable on algorithms now... :(

All of our games are being included in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25142/Devcats/]DEVCATS BUNDLE[/url] at their release – therefore you can always buy the game with an extra 20% discount if you have our previous games!

So, let’s cut to the games...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2007350/Cozy_Room/
[h1]COZY ROOM[/h1]
This is our main announcement of the day! You’ve just won a free game!! Cozy Room is a virtual room where you can enjoy the world’s most amazing companionship: Mr. Fofiño! 

Decorate your room and do whatever you need in this relaxing environment. Customize your room and unlock decor items by solving puzzles that tell the rescue story of our dear Fofiño (latin word for “cute and fluffy”). 

You can also build your own playlist, directly from your computer, with your favorite music.
Cozy Room is planned to be released in August/September.


[h1]SUDOCATS[/h1]
Despite Zodiacats being our first release, Sudocats was our very first game – we had some setbacks in the project and that’s why there were so many things done wrong. We solved all Sudocats problems in the first month and now we’re updating something strongly requested by you all: real cats pictures! Below, an example with our CEO Judy:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41043020/c2081e2496ac2e028002e5841e04243dd694033c.png[/img]

This image is not merely illustrative: Sudocats WILL BE LAUNCHED in Nintendo Switch!

Sudocats update will be online next week.


[h1]ZODIACATS[/h1]
We’re planning to add a glossary about sign attributes (we’re doing our homework to be as precise as we can). Also, the next update might come with a surprise… ;)
Zodiacats updates are on hold for now, unfortunately. That’s because of…


[h1]STEAM NEXT FEST[/h1]
We’ll be participating with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969080/A_Building_Full_of_Cats/]A Building Full of Cats[/url]’ demo. We have just a few weeks to finish the game, which is going to be released as soon as the festival is over. As we’re just five cats, we need every paw we have here (darn it, we wish we have thumbs!!!)
We had plans to launch a demo for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1961160/Cats_Love_Boxes/]Cats Love Boxes[/url] for this festival as well, but it seems we’re running out of time. We’re still working on it, anyhow. Its release is planned for July.


[h1]THE BLUE CAT[/h1]
This is currently our main project – therefore it might take way more time to be ready. It’s possible that we will release some other non-announced-games before launching The Blue Cat. Stay tunned!

That’s all folks!
Hope you liked our mews!
Love & Purrs,
DEVCATS

notes.title: New game: Sudocats
notes.content:
Hi, humans!
We've just released our second game.
Sudocats is a sudoku for cat people! 
Cats are wonderful creatures but you better not put them together without proper introduction. So, plan ahead to display them in the right order so they get along! 

[h3]Devcats Bundle[/h3]
We've created a bundle for those who already own Zodiacats, so you people can buy Sudocats with an extra discount. :D

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25142/Devcats/


[h3]The Blue Cat[/h3]
The Steam page for our next game is up!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1915870/The_Blue_Cat/

The Blue Cat tells the story of a little girl that finds a cat and learns about love and compassion.
Wishlist and follow the game now! ːkleinesː


[h3]Zodiacats[/h3]
Although we cats don't usually listen to what humans say, this time we heard you and we are planning some upcoming updates: we are doing a through research to provide to you a glossary on the astrological terms we have used in the game!

That's it for today. Time for a nap. ːsansː
Thank you.

notes.title: Night Mode & New Languages
notes.content:
Hi, humans!
Today is a special day: it's [b]World Cat Day[/b]! =^.^=
To celebrate, we are releasing a new update!

As a lot of you requested, we are here to announce the Night Mode: a darker mode for darker environments, so you can still relax without hurting your eyes. :)

We also included 4 (four) new languages.
Please note that we are cats and we barely speak human, so we apologize for anything that might be lost in translation.
[i](Human says that we are still a small dev company, so we can't afford a pro translator. We're deeply sorry!)[/i]

UPDATES:
- Night mode
- 4 new languages (Japanese, Chinese, Korean & Russian)
- Some mispelling fixed

Don't forget to wishlist our next game [i]Sudocats[/i], that will be released this March!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1725640/Sudocats/

notes.title: Night Mode is coming
notes.content:
We hear you, humans!
Some people are asking for a darker mode. As cats, we sometimes forget how limited human sight really is  so we didn't plan for a night mode, but we are making this happen.
Here's a message from Catherine:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vkXFTEG.png[/img]
[i]"We’re currently working on a “night mode”, a new mode to sooth the eyes in darker environments. We want to provide a relaxing gameplay no matter your surroundings!
Hope you like, humans!"[/i]
